integrity: Universal reduction: composite solutions are odd and squarefree, require \(\psi(n)/n>3\), and satisfy pairwise forbidden residues. Exhaustively enumerating all fifteen compatible small-prime intersections and proving fifteen exact rational-product inequalities excludes support at most \(709\). An independent finite residue scan is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Necessary support bound only. It neither constructs a composite solution of \(\psi(n)\equiv1\pmod n\), proves none exists, nor shows \(710\) is the optimal bound.
title: A 710-prime-support barrier for Dedekind’s residue-one congruence
